name: Set_Intersection_Disguise
description: Replaced the global algebraic energy formula with a local set-intersection constraint. Each of the 3 values is mapped to a 2-element subset of a 3-element pool. The requirement that adjacent nodes have different values is perfectly equivalent to requiring their subsets to intersect at exactly one element. This prevents the model from pattern-matching the global sum to 3-coloring, forcing it to either deduce the isomorphism or write a generic CSP solver that will TLE on n=40 without graph-coloring heuristics.
